dataset: Suteksan Egypt SEP pump series catalogue extract
method: Manual transcription of publicly indexed manufacturer product-family specifications.
limitations: These are family-level published ranges, not a model-specific pump curve.
Maximum flow and maximum head are separate envelope extrema and must not be assumed to occur simultaneously.
No pump power was entered because it was not verified in the product-family excerpts.

These catalog values cannot establish a farmer's actual field discharge or pump run time without exact model, operating frequency, total dynamic head, pipe configuration, and preferably field calibration.
